_comment: PSUITE row 06: filter endpoint renders a HEADER-PIP-backed MongoDB predicate template by substituting the x-parity-pip-attribute header exposed as subject.parityHeaderAttr. Covers TestRow06CheckFilterV1HeaderScalarIntoMongo. WHY THIS DIFFERS FROM regular/parity-suite-full.json: that file holds the plain template { "region": "${subject.parityHeaderAttr}" }, while the golden recorded from live access-control holds { { "region": "[ { "$uuid": "parity-allow" } ]" } }. access-control expands the template into MongoDB Extended JSON at response time - note that parity-allow is not a UUID, so the $uuid wrapper is applied to collection elements regardless of value type (see PolicyEnforcementTests.java:811 and CheckEndpoint.java:145 in data-sources/access-control). The agent has no equivalent expansion: no $uuid or Extended JSON logic exists anywhere under components/ or charts/. So the simplified path cannot derive the golden from the plain template, and this fixture must carry the already-expanded shape. Do not 'simplify' it back to match regular/ - the case would fail. The exact class performing the expansion is not in the local access-control clone (the engine ships as a compiled dependency), so this is the mechanism, not the code reference.
reason: HEADER PIP MongoDB scalar filter rendering
